environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance running behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a public subnet. The Flask app listens directly on port 8080, NLB forwards TCP traffic on port 443 (TLS terminated at app) to port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection or filtering layer exists between the client and the application.

config.tls_termination: at application (nginx sidecar with proxy_pass to localhost:8080)
